decision.llm_reasoning: The course content does not specify Objective-C as the programming language used.

evidence.text: The Object-Oriented Programming course provides basic knowledge and skills on the object-oriented programming methodology: concepts (class, object, data abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism...), object-oriented problem-solving approaches; skills in analyzing, designing, implementing, and testing programs using the object-oriented method.

Explain the fundamental knowledge of object-oriented programming, including concepts: class, object, attribute, method, inheritance, polymorphism, template. Design or read class diagram designs and implement programs using an object-oriented approach; Design and implement problems related to operator overloading, function overloading, and device-independent input/output streams.
Proficiently apply knowledge and skills in object-oriented programming and tools to solve specific problems using an object-oriented approach.
Proactively research and acquire knowledge, possess self-learning awareness and a serious attitude in practicing object-oriented programming skills.
Explain basic concepts in object-oriented programming; read simple class diagrams; implement classes, class diagrams, relationships between classes, and implement and test programs.
Perform operator overloading techniques in object-oriented programming; perform specific techniques in object-oriented programming such as: virtual methods, abstract base classes, templates.
Constructors, Destructors, the 'this' Pointer, and Inheritance
Constructors, Destructors, and Private Attribute Access
